findings.title: In-place resize cannot fit the node
findings.cause: container resize exits because the API server refused the in-place resize it asked for: pod batch's node has 4000m cpu allocatable, and the resize asks for 64000m; a resize never moves a pod to a bigger node; its log says: "Error from server (Forbidden): pods \"batch\" is forbidden: node didn't have enough allocatable resources: cpu, requested: 64000, allocatable: 4000"

evidence.what: last lines of container resize's log (current run)
evidence.detail: Error from server (Forbidden): pods "batch" is forbidden: node didn't have enough allocatable resources: cpu, requested: 64000, allocatable: 4000

evidence.what: pod batch's requests and its node
evidence.command: kubectl get pod batch -n kd-resize-infeasible -o jsonpath='{.spec.nodeName}{" "}{.spec.containers[*].resources}'

findings.fix: Ask for no more cpu than pod batch's node can hold, or recreate the pod with the new requests so the scheduler places it on a node with room.
